subject.title: Feature: Auto-leave WhatsApp groups not in allowlist + group-join webhook

question: Should OpenClaw’s bundled WhatsApp plugin offer an opt-in unauthorized-group leave policy, and if so should it be limited to configured group admission misses or also cover sender-level `groupAllowFrom` denials and owner notifications?
rationale: The choice determines a destructive membership boundary, the meaning of existing allowlist settings, the privacy scope of event payloads, and whether this should align with the broader cross-channel pairing design.

options.title: Define a narrow WhatsApp-only leave policy
options.body: Add one explicit opt-in policy for unconfigured or unapproved group admission, with a privacy-safe owner notification and no new generic hook until a cross-channel contract exists.

options.title: Fold it into group pairing
options.body: Defer the leave and notification design until the cross-channel pairing direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/11489 defines shared semantics.

options.title: Keep passive denial only
options.body: Retain current drop-and-diagnostic behavior and direct security-conscious operators to configuration and manual membership cleanup.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow WhatsApp-only leave policy
recommendation.body: Add one explicit opt-in policy for unconfigured or unapproved group admission, with a privacy-safe owner notification and no new generic hook until a cross-channel contract exists.
